title: EfficientSkill: Learning Skills for Token-Efficient Multi-Turn Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.19823v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reflective skill optimizers improve multi-turn LLM agents by revising instructions from failed and successful rollouts, yet accumulating edge-case rules bloats prompts, inflates token use, and pushes agents into long, error-prone loops. We introduce EfficientSkill, a two-step framework that first discovers a reliable skill without token penalties, and then warm-starts accuracy-guarded pruning from that skill to compress instructions, bound agent turns, and offload reusable code into workspace utilities with zero implementation prompt cost. Across four frontier, mid-tier, and open-weight models on MATH-500, ALFWorld, and SpreadsheetBench, EfficientSkill cuts output tokens over unconstrained EvoSkill on 11 of 12 configurations (by up to 80%) while raising mean accuracy on every benchmark, including +14.3 and +17.5 percentage-point gains on SpreadsheetBench with Gemini 3.8 Flash and Grok 4.1 Fast by replacing stalled loops with compact wo

translated_title: EfficientSkill：面向Token高效多轮智能体的技能学习
translated_abstract: 反思式技能优化器通过从失败和成功的回合中修订指令来改进多轮LLM智能体，然而不断累积的边缘情况规则会使提示词臃肿、推高token消耗，并使智能体陷入漫长且易出错的循环。我们提出EfficientSkill，这是一个两步框架：第一步在不施加token惩罚的情况下发现可靠技能；第二步从该技能热启动进行精度保护的剪枝，以压缩指令、限制智能体回合数，并将可复用代码卸载为工作区工具，且零实现提示成本。在四个前沿、中端及开源权重模型上，针对MATH-500、ALFWorld和SpreadsheetBench三个基准，EfficientSkill在12个配置中的11个上相比无约束的EvoSkill减少了输出token（最高减少80%），同时在所有基准上都提升了平均准确率，其中包括通过用紧凑工作流替代停滞循环，在SpreadsheetBench上使用Gemini 3.8 Flash和Grok 4.1 Fast分别取得+14.3和+17.5个百分点的准确率提升。
tldr: EfficientSkill提出“先无惩罚发现可靠技能、再进行精度保护剪枝”的两步框架，通过压缩指令、限制回合数和卸载可复用代码，在提升多轮LLM智能体准确率的同时最多减少80%的输出token消耗。
en_tdlr: EfficientSkill is a two-step framework that first discovers a reliable skill without token penalties and then applies accuracy-guarded pruning to compress instructions, bound agent turns, and offload reusable code, cutting output tokens by up to 80% while improving accuracy across multiple benchmarks and models.
